Core Smoke is push-triggered and report-only, so a pull request cannot prove the fixed spec in CI; the merge-commit push is the first hosted validation of the browser fix.

Address recycling depends on the Go runtime and GC, so the invariant test (distinct connections must not share a cache key) is the deterministic guard; the foreign-verdict scenario test only reproduces the CI sequence under GC pressure.

The cache namespace is derived from the DSN host and database name. Two different physical servers behind the same host:port/dbname string would share a namespace; the repository runs a single logical database, so this is recorded rather than engineered around.
